scenario.capacity_basis: Explicit scenario capacity for Iroi, Mint and Sakiri; no frozen projection is inferred by this fixture.
scenario.timeline: 25 ordinary Normal inputs form five 5-input chains at 0s..24s; Skill starts at 25s and its nine packets land at 25.5s; the 100-cost Burst starts at 26s and hits at 26.0001s; one 5-input Normal chain continues at 27s..31s. The denominator is the complete 32-second horizon.
scenario.heal_settlement: The Skill heals once at 25s; the Burst's one-time heal follows its direct hit at 26.0001s. Source MaxHP is 20000 for all three recipients.

independent_oracle.skill_buff_boundary: The cast-time 5% DEF-ignore applies to Iroi through TeamAll. The +200 ATK grant is self-excluded, so Iroi's own Skill, Burst and continued Normal use 1000 ATK. Skill impact is explicitly delayed 500ms past the grant.

energy_packets.pre_burst_source_charge: 5*22.047 + 4.798 = 115.033; at capacity 100, 100 is retained, 15 overflows, and 33/1000 carries before the cost.
energy_packets.source_after_burst_and_continuation: Spend 100 once at 26s, then 22.047 combines with 33/1000 carry: 22 granted; final energy 22, cumulative granted 137, overflow 15 and carry 2/25.
energy_packets.each_other_living_recipient: 137.080*3/5 = 82.248; each ends at 82 energy with carry 31/125 and no overflow.

healing.skill_coordinate_1: 20000*943/1000 = 18860 gross per recipient; Iroi and Mint each receive 10000 and overflow 8860, Sakiri is full and overflows 18860.
healing.burst_coordinate_1: 20000*1413/1000 = 28260 gross per recipient after Skill fills the injured actors; all three are full, so applied is 0 and overflow is 28260 each.

checks: python tools/cargo.py test --package ntesim-content iroi_zero_start_skill_burst_rotation_reconciles_damage_healing_and_energy passed. Rust checks all 106 packet identities and exact damage, 105 per-hit charge receipts, the sole 100-energy Burst spend, source and ally final ledgers, six heal settlements, HP caps, and direct-hit-before-Burst-heal order.

node tools/web.mjs test tests/character_actions.test.mjs passed. The Iroi fixture compiles the authored example, normalizes the bounded input schedule, checks exact WASM damage/healing/energy ledgers and replay, and compares the actual Worker request report.
Buff ordering is tested with 500ms from Skill cast to packet delivery; the +ATK team grant remains self-excluded and DEF-ignore includes Iroi.
limits: Synthetic 1000 ATK, zero resistance/crit and the 32-second schedule are independent runner checks, not game measurements or an optimal rotation.
Ordinary packet ChargeAdd eligibility, the 3/5 distribution, recipient life rules and chain reset/cadence are bounded owner hypotheses; native caller/animation timing remains open.
The 500ms Skill impact delay deliberately resolves the cast-time buff boundary in this scenario; native Skill packet timing is not established by this test.

Only Iroi's one-time Skill and post-cast Burst heals are included. Continuous TreatPeriod, Imagination, Regression/revival, summon behavior, Branch/hold, Blossom copies and off-field lifecycles remain unsupported.
